description: Attach an already-uploaded artifact (version code) to a release — the required step between upload_bundle and start_rollout. Uploading a bundle does NOT attach it, so without this the release has no artifact and start_rollout refuses. Identify the artifact by artifact_id, or give version_code and it is looked up among the app's processed artifacts. Carries the release's existing name and notes forward untouched. Reads the release back afterwards and returns attach_verified plus the attached version codes rather than assuming success. This does NOT publish — call start_rollout for that, and confirm with the user first.

artifact_id.description: Optional: the artifact id to attach. Omit and pass version_code instead to have it looked up.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

release_id.description: The release to attach to, from get_track or create_release.

track_id.description: Numeric track id from list_tracks (the aliases "internal"/"production" are not accepted).

version_code.description: Optional: version code of the uploaded bundle; used to find the artifact when artifact_id is omitted.

name: attach_artifact_to_release
